title: Normative reference for Per-Message Compression Extension (RFC 7692)?
body:
### What is the issue with the WebSockets Standard?

I noticed that there is no normative reference for [RFC 7692](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7692.html) in https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#normative

However, [establish a WebSocket connection](https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-websocket-establish) step 9 mentions the Sec-WebSocket-Extensions header defined in RFC 7692, and references the original WebSocket standard RFC instead of the extension's RFC in the trailing reference link.

> 9. Let permessageDeflate be a user-agent defined "permessage-deflate" extension [header value](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#header-value). [[WSP]](https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#biblio-wsp)
> 10. [Append](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-append) (`Sec-WebSocket-Extensions`, permessageDeflate) to request’s [header list](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-header-list).

This leads to two questions:
1. Should step 9 of establish a WebSocket connection normatively reference RFC 7692?
2. Is a user agent that does not support `permessage-deflate` conforming to the WhatWG WebSockets standard?
